ov: زبانة (الإنجليزية: Zabana!) هو فيلم دراما تم إنتاجه في الجزائر وصدر في سنة 2012.
plotEn: Zabana! (Arabic: زبانة) is a 2012 Algerian drama film directed by Saïd Ould Khelifa. The film was selected as the Algerian entry for the Best Foreign Language Oscar at the 85th Academy Awards, but it did not make the final shortlist.
